content: Academic MIR research: score-to-performance alignment (ASAP dataset) is foundational for localizing performance events on the score; performance-error-detection algorithms identify pitch errors, extra/missing notes from alignment; a 2024 TCN-based 'conspicuous-mistake' detector works on MIDI pianoroll without needing a reference score. 2026 'Profy' (DIS'26) system uses 1kHz key-motion+audio and weak take-level labels to produce time-aligned score/timeline highlights for review/scrubbing/looping, addressing the same problem as summary-only feedback being hard to act on.
